name: KlarnaUSD
oneLiner: KlarnaUSD is Klarna's planned USD stablecoin on Tempo, issued via Bridge (Stripe) Open Issuance; mainnet contracts and reserves pending.
collateral: Planned USD-denominated reserve assets managed through Bridge Open Issuance; public reserve composition and attestations are pending mainnet launch
pegMechanism: Pre-launch USD stablecoin built on Bridge Open Issuance and Tempo testnet infrastructure; expected to mint and redeem through Bridge/Klarna regulated channels once public issuance begins, with contracts and reserve reporting still pending
launchPhaseDetail: Tempo mainnet live since March 18 but KlarnaUSD still absent — USD1 (WLFI) launched on Tempo May 8 as first native stablecoin, beating KlarnaUSD to market; Bridge OCC charter approved Feb 2026; KlarnaUSD absent from Bridge Open Issuance live issuer list. Klarna's Q1 2026 earnings (May 14) made no mention of KlarnaUSD, and it was absent from Stripe Sessions 2026 Open Issuance partner announcements — no new official KlarnaUSD communication since the Nov 2025 announcement; IPO completed Sep 2025 (NYSE: KLAR), KlarnaUSD in F-1 prospectus as strategic initiative
